payload.text:
On 14 February 1990, Voyager 1 turned its camera back toward home from about 6 billion km away. Earth came out smaller than a single pixel. 34 minutes later, Voyager 1 switched its cameras off forever.

Source:
NASA Science, Pale Blue Dot Revisited: https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/pale-blue-dot-revisited/
NASA NSSDCA Planetary Fact Sheet: https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/

Images: NASA / JPL-Caltech (Pale Blue Dot, 2020 reprocessing), NASA / JPL / KSC (Voyager 1 launch). Narration uses a synthetic voice.

#astronomy #space #science #skyschool #voyager #palebluedot
